## About
Platinum Auto Body and Painting is a family owned, independent shop on E Edinger Ave in Santa Ana. The Jasso family stands behind all the work we do on your vehicle, whether it's a small dent, a bumper, a body kit or a full paint job.
We work directly with your insurance company when needed, and we welcome all insurance claims. We also still do custom projects, some of which have been featured in Eurotuner and SEMA.
We're a little tucked away, and our signs may still read A&B Autobody. Customers rate us 4.9 from 50 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair and paint: Bodywork and paint after an accident, with cars returned to manufacturer's specification.
- Dent and scratch removal: Bumper, dent and fender repair, plus scratches and scrapes. If your leased car is dented or scraped, we'll find and repair the damage before you turn it in.
- Fiberglass and rust repair: Repair for fiberglass panels and rust damage.
- Body kits and full paint: From a small dent or bumper to a body kit or a full car paint service.
- Custom bodywork: Custom bodywork projects to make your vehicle one of a kind.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No appointment is necessary. Just stop by during business hours.

Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: Yes. We welcome all insurance claims and will work directly with your insurance company when needed.

Q: Can you help with towing or a rental car?
A: Yes, towing and a rental car are available.

Q: I can't find the shop. Am I in the right place?
A: We're a little tucked away on E Edinger Ave in Santa Ana, and our signs may still read A&B Autobody.
